CursorPaginationMeta.title: CursorPaginationMeta
CursorPaginationMeta.description:
Metadata returned with every paginated list response.

Fields:
    next_cursor: Opaque string the client must send as ``cursor=`` on the
                 next request.  None when there are no further pages.
    has_more:    True when at least one more page exists.
    page_size:   Number of items requested for this page.
    total:       Total matching rows in the database (unaffected by cursor).
